description: Real EWS frontend served from backend/app/static, built from the docs/mockup visual design but fed entirely by the FEAT-001 REST API + WebSocket (NOT localStorage, NOT the mockup files as a data source). Dashboard: YG2UFH-branded dark UI matching the mockup color tokens, a Leaflet/OpenStreetMap map plotting registered nodes, node/gateway cards, kabupaten/kecamatan filters, and the DASHBOARD alarm (card blink red=awas / amber=siaga, Web Audio beep with no sound file, a prominent alarm banner, and a MUTE button) driven by live WS messages. Node-detail page: Chart.js charts (tilt with SIAGA 2 deg / AWAS 5 deg dashed threshold lines, BME280 weather, EPEVER power) plus health stats, from the node history + thresholds API. Depends on FEAT-001 (consumes its API/WS contract and populates the static/ dir + /node.html route it created).
steps: Read FIRST: the absolute context.json (c:/aws-kiro/EWS_YG2UFH/.agents/tasks/task-ews-tahap1/context.json) and this file, plus FEAT-001.json findings for the exact REST routes and WS message shapes. Open docs/mockup/dashboard.html and docs/mockup/node.html as VISUAL reference only — mirror layout/style/color tokens, do NOT modify them, do NOT copy their localStorage data logic.

Write backend/app/static/css/app.css carrying the mockup's dark theme tokens (--bg #121417, --panel #1c2025, --border #2c333b, --accent #e23b3b, --amber #d29922, --green #2ea043, --blue #2f81f7, --text #e6edf3, --dim #8b949e), the topbar/card/grid layout, the alarm-bar + btn-mute styles, and the blink keyframes blinkAwas/blinkSiaga with classes alarm-awas/alarm-siaga — matching the mockup.

Write backend/app/static/index.html (dashboard): topbar with YG2UFH brand + 'EWS Longsor' title + broker/clock status; a kabupaten + kecamatan filter control populated from GET /api/kabupaten and GET /api/kabupaten/{kab}/kecamatan; an alarm banner + an alarm-bar with a MUTE button; a grid of node/gateway cards; a Leaflet map div; link Leaflet CSS/JS and Chart.js via the same CDNs the mockups use. No login overlay, no chat, no localStorage data (RBAC role badge MAY appear as static UI only).

Write backend/app/static/js/dashboard.js: on load, fetch GET /api/nodes and GET /api/kabupaten to render cards + populate filters + place Leaflet markers (color by status: green ok, amber siaga, red offline/awas; square icon for gateway) with popups; wire the kabupaten/kecamatan filters to re-fetch /api/nodes?kabupaten=&kecamatan= and redraw. Open a WebSocket to /ws/live; on {type:'reading'} update the matching card/marker live; on {type:'alarm'} add the alarm-awas/alarm-siaga blink class to the node card, show the banner + alarm-bar text, and play a Web Audio beep (AudioContext + OscillatorNode, no media file) — unless muted. Implement the MUTE toggle (btn-mute) that silences the beep and clears blink until a new alarm. Clicking a card navigates to node.html?id=<node_id>. Reconnect the WS on close.

Write backend/app/static/node.html (detail): topbar + back link, a head card (node id, location, status pill, coordinates), and a 2-column grid of chart cards (Tilt, Weather BME280, Power EPEVER) plus a health stats card (RSSI/SNR/uptime/fw). Load Chart.js from CDN.

Write backend/app/static/js/node.js: read id from the URL query, fetch GET /api/nodes/{id} (render head + health from latest payload; show a not-found panel if 404) and GET /api/nodes/{id}/history?hours=48, and GET /api/thresholds to get the node's resolved SIAGA/AWAS values. Render Chart.js line charts: tilt delta over time with two dashed horizontal threshold lines labeled SIAGA and AWAS at the resolved values, weather (temp/hum/press), power (batt_v/pv_v) — using history points. Use chart styling matching the mockup (dark grid, dim ticks).

Verify the app serves the real frontend: from backend/ set env MQTT_BROKER_HOST=127.0.0.1 and MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX=yg2ufh/ews, start uvicorn on :8001 in the BACKGROUND (Start-Process ...; do NOT block), wait ~3s, then Invoke-WebRequest the pages and APIs; stop the process afterward; delete any temp data/*.db*.

Set this FEAT's status to completed in FEAT-002.json and record in findings any API fields the frontend relied on (so FEAT-003's end-to-end check and docs match). Commit locally on the branch; never push.
acceptance_criteria: With the app running on :8001 (background), GET http://127.0.0.1:8001/ returns 200 and the HTML body contains 'YG2UFH' and a Leaflet map container and references dashboard.js.
GET http://127.0.0.1:8001/node.html returns 200 and references Chart.js and node.js.
GET http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/nodes returns 200 (frontend data source reachable).
The frontend reads node data from the REST API / WebSocket, not from localStorage, and the docs/mockup files remain unmodified.
dashboard.js contains the dashboard-alarm behavior: a blink class toggle (alarm-awas/alarm-siaga), a Web Audio beep (AudioContext/OscillatorNode, no media file), and a working MUTE toggle.
verification: From backend/ (env MQTT_BROKER_HOST=127.0.0.1, MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX=yg2ufh/ews): start uvicorn on :8001 in the background, wait ~3s, then PowerShell `Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:8001/ -UseBasicParsing` (StatusCode 200, Content contains 'YG2UFH'), `Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:8001/node.html -UseBasicParsing` (200), `Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/nodes -UseBasicParsing` (200); then stop the uvicorn process.
Re-run `.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/ -v` to confirm the backend still passes after frontend/static changes.
Delete any temp data/*.db* created during verification; leave no uvicorn process running.

findings.summary: FEAT-002 implemented and verified. Real EWS frontend served from backend/app/static, fed entirely by the FEAT-001 REST API + /ws/live WebSocket (NO localStorage, mockup files untouched). Files: css/app.css (mockup dark-theme tokens, topbar/card/grid, alarm-bar + btn-mute, blinkAwas/blinkSiaga keyframes + alarm-awas/alarm-siaga classes), index.html (dashboard: YG2UFH topbar + clock + broker status, kabupaten/kecamatan filters, alarm banner + alarm-bar with MUTE, node-card grid, Leaflet map, live alarm log), js/dashboard.js (fetch nodes/kabupaten, render cards + Leaflet markers, WS live reading/alarm handling, blink + Web Audio beep + MUTE), node.html + js/node.js (Chart.js tilt/weather/power/RSSI from history + resolved thresholds). Verification: background uvicorn :8001 -> / 200 (contains YG2UFH, map container, dashboard.js), /node.html 200 (Chart.js + node.js), /api/nodes 200, /css/app.css 200, /js/dashboard.js 200 (alarm-awas blink class, AudioContext/createOscillator beep, btnMute toggle all present); pytest 20 passed; uvicorn stopped; temp data/*.db* deleted.

api_fields_frontend_relied_on.GET /api/nodes (+ ?kabupaten=&kecamatan=: list[NodeOut]; dashboard reads node_id, tipe (gateway detection: 'gateway'/'gw' => square marker), kabupaten, lat, lon, status ('offline' => red), alarm.level ('awas'/'siaga' => blink + marker color), and payload.{weather:{temp,hum,press}, power:{batt_v,pv_v,soc}, health:{rssi}, tilt:{delta|x}} for card body. Status priority used by frontend: offline > alarm awas > alarm siaga > online.
api_fields_frontend_relied_on.GET /api/kabupaten/{kab}/kecamatan: list[KecamatanOut] {id,nama}; populates the kecamatan <select> after a kabupaten is chosen.
api_fields_frontend_relied_on.GET /api/nodes/{id}: NodeOut; node page reads node_id, nama, kabupaten, kecamatan, lat, lon, status, alarm.level, payload.health.{rssi,snr,uptime,fw}. 404 => not-found panel.
api_fields_frontend_relied_on.GET /api/nodes/{id}/history?hours=48: list[HistoryPointOut] {received_at, ts, payload}; charts read payload.tilt.{delta|x}, payload.weather.{temp,hum,press}, payload.power.{batt_v,pv_v}, payload.health.rssi. x-axis labels from ts (epoch s) else received_at.
api_fields_frontend_relied_on.GET /api/thresholds: list[ThresholdOut] {scope,tilt_siaga,tilt_awas}; node page resolves scope 'node:<id>' override else 'global' to draw the dashed SIAGA/AWAS tilt threshold lines (default 2.0/5.0).
api_fields_frontend_relied_on.WS /ws/live: {type:'reading', node_id, kabupaten, ts, received_at, payload, alarm} updates the matching card + marker live; {type:'alarm', level, source, reason, ts} adds blink to card id 'card-<sanitized node_id>', shows banner + alarm-bar, logs the row, and plays the Web Audio beep unless muted.

dashboard_alarm_behavior.blink: card gets class alarm-awas (level awas or status offline) or alarm-siaga (level siaga); cleared on MUTE and re-derived on each render.
dashboard_alarm_behavior.beep: Web Audio only (AudioContext + OscillatorNode, square wave, 880Hz for awas / 523Hz for siaga, ~0.5s envelope). No media file. Suppressed while muted.
dashboard_alarm_behavior.mute: btnMute toggles state.muted: silences the beep and clears all current blink + hides the alarm-bar; blink/beep resume only on a NEW alarm after unmute.
dashboard_alarm_behavior.ws_reconnect: WebSocket auto-reconnects 2s after close; broker status dot reflects connected/reconnecting.

verification_results.serve_check: background uvicorn :8001 -> / 200 (YG2UFH + '#map' container + dashboard.js), /node.html 200 (chart.umd + node.js), /api/nodes 200, /css/app.css 200, /js/dashboard.js 200 (alarm-awas, AudioContext, createOscillator, btnMute present), process stopped
verification_results.cleanup: temp data/*.db* removed; only data/.gitkeep remains; no uvicorn left running
